from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    color=min((v for v in counts if v!=0), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    mask=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    mh=max(r for r,c in mask)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in mask)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
      for c in range(w-mw+1):
        if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in mask):
          for dr,dc in mask: out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return out
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(pairs,1):

    points = [(r, c) for r in range(height) for c in range(width) if grid[r][c] == color]
    top = min(r for r, _ in points)
    left = min(c for _, c in points)

    mask = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points]
    mask_height = max(r for r, _ in mask) + 1
    mask_width = max(c for _, c in mask) + 1

    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(height - mask_height + 1):
        for c in range(width - mask_width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in mask):
                for dr, dc in mask:
                    output[r + dr][c + dc] = color
    return output
